svg.title: Content Factory — featured project
svg.desc: Private TypeScript platform in production: omnichannel inbox, CRM and sales, AI agent Merlin, Git-backed website CMS, warehouse, payments, marketing analytics, ops and security. 340k+ lines of TypeScript, 131 database migrations, 230 test suites, 80 API route modules, 35 background jobs.
